_: The TikZ benchmark's pictures (paths, styles, transforms, \foreach; and nodes: text, anchors, placement), written for this benchmark. src: a tikzpicture's body. iou: the least ink overlap (within 0.24 pt) the picture is held to, recorded from its first run, with why when it is not the default.

pictures.name: arcs
pictures.src: \draw (0,0) arc (0:120:1.5); \draw[thick] (3,0) arc (-30:200:1); \draw (0,-2) arc [start angle=180, end angle=360, radius=1];

pictures.name: arrows-to
pictures.why: only thin horizontal lines: Chrome's antialiased 0.4 pt line is wider than pdftoppm's along all of it (the tips agree)

pictures.name: labelled-axes
pictures.src: \draw[->] (-0.5,0) -- (3.5,0) node[right] {$x$}; \draw[->] (0,-0.5) -- (0,2.5) node[above] {$y$}; \foreach \x in {1,2,3} \draw (\x,0.1) -- (\x,-0.1) node[below] {$\x$}; \draw[thick, blue] (0,0) -- (3,2) node[above left] {$y=\frac{2}{3}x$};

pictures.name: unit-circle-labels
pictures.src: \draw[->] (-1.5,0) -- (1.5,0) node[right] {$x$}; \draw[->] (0,-1.5) -- (0,1.5) node[above] {$y$}; \draw (0,0) circle (1); \draw[red, thick] (0,0) -- (40:1) node[above right] {$P$}; \draw (0.3,0) arc (0:40:0.3) node[midway, right] {$\theta$};
